item.title: North Shore Rescue helps save snowboarder stuck at Cypress
item.description: North Shore Rescue (NSR) safely recovered a snowboarder who got stuck in steep, slippery terrain in the Cypress Mountain area Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: Courtney Sarault wins bronze in women’s 500m short track speedskating
item.description: A great final lap by Canada’s Courtney Sarault led to an Olympic bronze medal. The Canadian short-track speedskater finished third with a big comeback in the women’s 500 metres on Thursday. item.title: RCMP seeking witnesses after driver strikes wheelchair user in North Vancouver
item.description: North Vancouver police are seeking the public's help in investigating an alleged hit-and-run that left a person seriously injured last week.

item.title: BC RCMP confirms identities of Tumbler Ridge mass shooting victims
item.description: The BC RCMP has confirmed the names of the eight victims of the Tumbler Ridge shooting on Tuesday.

item.title: B.C. Legislature holds moment of silence; Gov’t postponing spring session after Tumbler Ridge shooting
item.description: The B.C. government has postponed the opening of its spring legislative session Thursday, while MLAs held a moment of silence in the Chamber in honour of the eight victims of the Tumbler Ridge shooting.

item.title: GST credit top-up coming in spring after bill fast-tracked in Parliament
item.description: OTTAWA — Canadians who receive the GST benefit will get a one-time top up payment this spring after parliamentarians fast-tracked the legislation to set it motion. item.title: ‘Everybody is just devastated’, vigils held across B.C. after Tumbler Ridge mass shooting
item.description: As B.C. marks a Day of Mourning for the victims of the Tumbler Ridge mass shooting, people across the province are supporting the community through makeshift memorials and candlelight vigils.

item.title: Bangladesh Nationalist Party claims victory in country’s first election since 2024 uprising
item.description: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party has claimed victory in the country’s first election since the 2024 uprising, positioning itself to form the next government and potentially reshape Bangladesh’s political landscape after years of intense rivalry and disputed polls.

item.title: Survivor of Polytechnique shooting shares experience after Tumbler Ridge tragedy
item.description: Following the horrific incident in Tumbler Ridge, a prominent survivor of a mass shooting is sharing her experience with grief after traumatic events.

item.title: Multiple million dollars in tips still unaccounted for as B.C. restaurants demand answers from app
item.description: Many hospitality businesses across B.C. are dealing with lost tips as an app that distributes that money is malfunctioning.
